geometry.orientation: projecting outward from the panicle surface
geometry.size_relative: Approximately 2-3x the length of adjacent normal grains
geometry.width_relative: Similar width to adjacent normal grains

distribution.pattern: Scattered throughout the visible panicle section

spatial_location.position: On the surface of the panicle head

reproductive_structure.details: Individual florets appear to be transformed into or occupied by the dark structures

developmental_stage.details: Grains are fully formed and visible
